answer: The glacier assignment is published and knoll records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the plume graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 816 impostors cost 1963 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
